command:
set -euo pipefail
export DISPLAY=:0
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000
export XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority
COMMIT=8102548c376b0f0bc6cc09f5b1064636f902a2b0
REPO=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
SHADOW=$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html
PRE_HASH=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
PRE_PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo PRE_HASH=$PRE_HASH
echo PRE_PID=$PRE_PID
echo SHADOW_HASH=$(sha256sum "$SHADOW" | awk '{print $1}')
git -C "$REPO" fetch -q origin "$COMMIT"
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-v6-matrix.XXXXXX)
cleanup(){ git -C "$REPO" worktree remove --force "$TMP/repo" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$TMP"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
git -C "$REPO" worktree add --detach "$TMP/repo" "$COMMIT" >/dev/null
DIR=$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity
python3 -m py_compile "$DIR/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_visible_x11_v6.py"
echo PY_COMPILE_PASS
i=0
for mode in normal_blink special_raw special_predecoded; do
  i=$((i+1)); http=$((9410+i*10)); cdp=$((http+1)); OUT=$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_scheduler_visible_v6_${mode}_20260912_1017
  rm -rf "$OUT"
  echo === MODE=$mode HTTP=$http CDP=$cdp ===
  GO_EYE_MODE="$mode" python3 "$DIR/diagnose_shadow_scheduler_visible_x11_v6.py" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port "$http" --cdp-port-base "$cdp"
  python3 - "$OUT/report.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); r=x['rows'][0]; print(json.dumps({'schema':x['schema'],'scope':x['scope'],'live_source_unchanged':x['live_source_unchanged'],'mode':r['mode'],'surface':r.get('surface'),'before_trigger':r.get('before_trigger'),'trigger':r.get('trigger'),'predecode_complete':r.get('predecode_complete'),'final':r.get('final'),'error':r.get('error')},sort_keys=True))
PY
done
POST_HASH=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
POST_PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo POST_HASH=$POST_HASH
echo POST_PID=$POST_PID
test "$PRE_HASH" = "$POST_HASH"
test "$PRE_PID" = "$POST_PID"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet frankenstein-buehne.service
echo PRODUCTION_INVARIANCE_PASS
